title: EXCISE: Query-Side Exclusion for Late-Interaction Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.05497v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Late-interaction retrievers handle exclusion queries poorly. When a user asks for "X but not Z", the additive MaxSim score rewards the tokens that name Z, so documents about Z are promoted rather than suppressed, a failure we call exclusion inversion. We show that no method we tested on the frozen token embeddings recovers this constraint; the difficulty lies in identifying the excluded topic, which depends on the query alone. EXCISE therefore confines learning to the query path and leaves the index frozen. Two query-side modules (1.5M parameters in total) detect the excluded topic and re-embed a 100-document shortlist, and a parameter-free rule demotes the candidates that match it. Across six collections and three backbones, EXCISE outperforms each backbone's frozen and fine-tuned baselines on every collection. It raises ExcluIR success@10 from 0.10-0.22 to 0.84-0.85 and Boolean NOT accuracy from 0.25-0.29 to 0.84-0.92. Pooled over

translated_title: EXCISE：面向迟交互检索的查询端排除方法
translated_abstract: 迟交互检索器在处理排除查询时表现不佳。当用户提出"X但不包括Z"这类查询时，加性的MaxSim分数会奖励那些命名Z的词元，从而提升而非抑制关于Z的文档——我们将这种失败称为“排除反转”。我们证明，在冻结的词元嵌入上测试的所有方法都无法恢复这一约束；其困难在于识别被排除的主题，而这仅取决于查询本身。因此，EXCISE将学习限制在查询路径上，并保持索引冻结。两个查询端模块（总计150万参数）负责检测被排除的主题并对100篇文档的候选短名单重新嵌入，再由一个无参数规则降低匹配该主题的候选文档的排名。在六个数据集合和三个骨干模型上，EXCISE在每个数据集合上都优于各骨干模型的冻结基线和微调基线。它将ExcluIR的success@10从0.10-0.22提升至0.84-0.85，将布尔NOT准确率从0.25-0.29提升至0.84-0.92。
tldr: 提出EXCISE方法，通过仅在查询端训练两个轻量模块（共150万参数）来检测被排除的主题并对候选短名单重新嵌入，配合无参数的降权规则，在保持检索索引完全冻结的前提下，大幅提升迟交互检索器处理“X但不包括Z”类排除查询的能力。
en_tdlr: EXCISE trains lightweight query-side modules (1.5M parameters total) to detect excluded topics and demote matching candidates, dramatically fixing "exclusion inversion" in late-interaction retrieval for "X but not Z" queries while keeping the entire index frozen.
